svg.title: These are zeroth- and first-moment cancellations. For any additive real function F on the offset lattice, P α cαF(δα) = 0, by expressing F in its four coordinate values. The Hessian of each two-leg loop term is the sum of its two cross-leg curvature products. Shift the site summation so its first leg is at the same site for every α. Where the supported direction has nonzero discrete curvature, that site lies in its one-link enlargement. The other direction’s curvature, on this neighborhood enlarged by the loop length, is affine:
